notes.title: Boss Helicopter
notes.content:
[h1][b]Boss level redesigned, other levels rebalance, performance improvement![/b][/h1]

[b]▪ The "Boss Helicopter" level has been completely redesigned:
• The background of the level has been replaced, now it is more suitable for the story, 
• A beautiful level decoration has been produced,
• Improved the display of spawn bombs,
• Added movable elements and dangerous traps.

▪ Level #6 has been completely redesigned, previously players faced high difficulty of this level.

▪ The difficulty of level #18 has been slightly reduced.

▪ Improved timer display and positioning at all levels of the Story mode.

▪ The levels with puzzles have been added a visual display of the numbers of the levels.

▪ The version of the engine has been upgraded to the latest and corresponding to modern standards.

▪ Improved stability and performance.

▪ A lot of corrections, based on the requests of the players.

▪ Improved gamepad control.

▪ Fixed and optimized vibration on Xbox gamepads.

▪ Accelerated interaction with pause on all gamepads.

▪ Visually improved the effect of shaking during explosions.[/b]

[h3][b]Many other minor changes and fixes:[/b][/h3]
[b]▪ In order not to overload the news, I will not describe minor technical and imperceptible changes to the eye. But a lot of work has been done these days. Many thanks to all those who report bugs and problems! Thank you, dear players, thanks to you the game is getting better![/b]

notes.title: Story Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]A big Story Update, new cut scenes, other fixes and improvements![/b][/h1]

[h3][b]I am glad to inform you that in these difficult times I continue to support my games and add new content to them![/b][/h3]
[h3][b]Today TitTok gets what you've often asked for - its own storyline![/b][/h3]

[b]▪ Added a plot to TitTok and it is directly related to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1764810/TitTok_2/]TitTok 2[/url] - the game is released on Monday, March 7 at 02:00 PST

▪ The game has new, beautiful and stylish cut scenes at the beginning and end.

▪ New music has been added so that you don't get bored!

▪ The sound engine has been improved.

▪ The title screen has been updated, there is now more useful information.

▪ Added a scene after the credits.

▪ Redesigned the main menu. It has become more convenient.

▪ It is now possible to start a new game without losing your saves. You can start a new game for those players who are not familiar with the plot yet and want to watch the plot clips.

▪ All new text elements have been localized into supported languages.

▪ In the Boss level, the Boss health system has been redesigned, in accordance with the new TitTok series interface.

▪ In the last level, the character picks up a new plot item, instead of a key.

▪ Added protection of the configuration file from making incorrect changes.

▪ Improved vibration support in XboX gamepads.

▪ A large bunch of minor fixes and improvements *[/b]

notes.title: The Big Content Update
notes.content:
[h1]Big Content Update - new levels, new design, new stats, and more![/h1]


[h2]▪ Added THREE new levels![/h2]
[b]Especially created from scratch three different and completely new levels with platforming for our Kitty :)
Now he has room to run wild!
Buy? What? NO! This is a completely free addition of brand new content :)
Just decided to please you with new content and mechanics :)[/b]

[h3]▪ Achievements:[/h3]
[b]Don't worry those who opened all 100% achievements and retired. All is well! 
You don't have to go through new levels to get the achievements. They are already in your pocket :)[/b]

[h3]▪ Statistics:[/h3]
[b]And here you have a whole field of experiments to run wild in new levels and show your friends who's the PRO Gamer here!
Pass the new levels on speed and get into the world scoreboard stats![/b]

==========================

[h2]▪ Per player request:[/h2]
[b]In each level you can now quickly, even instantly restart the level by pressing the "R" key
I do not know why you need it, but if you asked - added :) You're welcome :)
Instantly restart the level can also be a gamepad, just press the right bumper, or whatever that thing over the trigger is called)) 0)
level is still possible to restart via "Esc" - > "Restart" or just die :'([/b]

==========================

[h2]▪ Redesign of the level selector and leaderboards:[/h2]
[b]The level selector screen is now ABSOLUTELY new. And 42 times more convenient than before! 
And why is that? Because![/b]

[h3]▪ Puzzle levels:[/h3]
[b]Completely separated from the main gameplay with platforming. Many have complained that gameplay is interrupted periodically by highly intelligent puzzle tasks...
Okay! Now gameplay is continuous, just like a presidential term :)
The choice of puzzles is now located separately, under the main levels. They are highlighted in color!
All puzzles are available immediately, and 100% free, heh :)
..Also, puzzles can be skipped. I do not know why, but you can :) Cool, huh? =)[/b]

[h3]▪ Leaderboards:[/h3]
[b]Now visually and tactilely more convenient. The icons of the leaderboards have been changed. And also their location under each level has become more convenient. Now you will definitely notice them.
Also now you have the ability to go to all of the game's world statistics right from the level selection screen! Just one click, and you see the best players in the world, and perhaps you're among them? :)[/b]

[h3]▪ Selector design:[/h3]
[b]redesigned and made much more intuitive, compact, informative, and beautiful. Now designers with higher education can move in and live there. Artemy Lebedev approves! Or not. How should I know?[/b]

==========================

[h2]▪ Especially for speedrunners:[/h2]
[b]Yes yes, the game is beloved by speedrunners, bow to you :) 
A little squeeze for you: 
▪ Game levels are now not interrupted by puzzles, you don't waste time skipping spots!
▪ The level is instantly restarted by pressing "R"! (on the gamepad - the right bumper)
▪ The transition to the next level, at the moment when the stat pops up is available by pressing the mouse AT ANY PLACE on the screen, as well as by pressing the keys: "Spacebar", "Enter", "Esc"[/b]

==========================

[h2]▪ Gamepads:[/h2]
[b]As always, support for current gamepads has been improved. Improved cues and icons for gamepads. Still prettier than ever.[/b]

==========================

[h3][b] Other fixes: [/b][/h3]
▪ A large, huge number of small, invisible fixes in the engine. Somewhere 14 million. Well, or a little less.
▪ I have a suspicion that I have not described everything. And this suspicion is very well justified.

notes.title: Ultra update-ee-e-e!
notes.content:
[h1][b]💣 THIS PATCH IS JUST A BIG! 💣[/b][/h1]
MEOW MEOW! ⚞ᴥ⚟ ⚞ᴥ⚟ ⚞ᴥ⚟ MOORE MOORE!
[h2][b]Clean up disk space, this bombing update will leave a huge funnel with a burst of functionality![/b][/h2]

[h3][b]TitTok:[/b][/h3]
[b]▪ Made control of gamepads in levels with Puzzles! FINALLY! WOW![/b]
▪ Full support for Sony Playstation and MS Xbox gamepads in puzzles! WOW!
▪ Added animated, beautiful, colorful tips for gamepads in puzzle levels.
▪ Reworked, improved, and added new icons for better visual display, for each supported gamepad.
▪ It was very difficult. But the puzzles are now completely sharpened under the arm under the gamepads. I hope everything is fine now :)

[b]▪ Puzzles are now more convenient not only visually, but also more pleasant for hearing. the movements of the elements are sounded.[/b]
▪ Tweaked the sound engine to meet the new high quality puzzle standards.
▪ Saving started working correctly if you decided to skip the puzzle and move on
▪ The "Next" button that appears after completing the puzzles has now become signed. Well, she became more beautiful. Perhaps. Or maybe she didn't. Who knows - let me know.

[b]▪ What about the level selection menu?[/b]
▪ Yes, everything is fine with him. it has become more beautiful. The icons are re-adapted for the keyboard with the mouse, and for the gamepad at the same time. So that you can see and understand everything and everything :)
▪ Using the i button on the keyboard and the corresponding buttons on the gamepad, you can call up a hint if you still manage to get confused.

[b] ▪ CARDINALLY re-created, rebuilt and shoveled the system of hints inside the gameplay! Everything is written from scratch, I hope you are happy :) [/b]
▪ Hints now appear once per level. Even if you die 42 times in a row, and then another 9000 times.
▪ Previously, clues appeared after each death. Disorder! Prompt spam Was! Now there is no. Generally.
▪ But if you suddenly did not have time to read the hint, and it has already run away - do not despair! Now there is an icon in the upper right corner, you can press "i" on the keyboard or the corresponding button on the gamepads, and the hint WILL APPEAR AGAIN! It's a miracle! This is incredible!
▪ Due to the new system of hints, the whole interface and some panels were redesigned, moved and repainted. And some panels are not.
▪ Fixed text in some tooltips. Small but disgusting mistakes! Phew to be like that!
▪ Hints can be completely and completely disabled in the settings, with one click. Well, they got these tips already.

[b] ▪ Main menu, what's there? Is it really the main thing? King to the palace! Sat on the throne, sat on the throne! Well, the main thing and the main thing .. [/b]
▪ The logo in this main menu now meows strangely ... If you click on it ... And if you don't click it, it DOESN'T MEOW! It's just some kind of paranormal phenomenon. Summon ghost hunters. Or the guardians of the galaxy. Call someone already!
▪ Buttons on the banner have become visually clearer. And more convenient. Hope.
▪ I corrected localization in all languages ​​where I noticed. Where I did not notice, I did not correct it. Sorry..


[h3][b]BOSS FIGHT! BOSS FIGHT[/b][/h3]
▪ How many complaints have I heard that the boss fight is easy. So I took and complicated this battle for you, bae baa: P
▪ Boss Helicopter became faster, faster, stronger. Even more persistent. See not to fall under his insistence!
▪ Fewer safe places to sit out. Much less. There is one such place left ..
▪ The door no longer gets in the way below your feet, it now ran upstairs and waits for you to defeat the Helicopter! Fru Tu Tu Tu Tu Tu Tu - THIS IS A HELICOPTER !!!!
▪ In short, you are hit. The helicopter is evil now. you better run. Meow and run as hard as you can!!!
▪ in the end, on the credits screen, I corrected everything. Improved a little. She sounded a little. It became more pleasant. I definitely did, heh)


[h3][b] TitTok Uncensored: [/b][/h3]
▪ Added legal cheat - when installing this add-on. access to ALL levels opens, for the most impatient strawberry lovers :)
▪ Levels with strawberries are now more highlighted and highlighted with a heart.
▪ Changed DLC page. Added more detailed content description. I hope no one gets confused now :)


[h3] [b] Achievements: [/b][/h3]
▪ All hidden achievements are now visible. Almost a week has passed since the release and there is no point in hiding the achievements. A guide to rare achievements is also available in the game hub :)


[h3][b] Other fixes: [/b][/h3]
▪ A large, huge number of small, invisible fixes in the engine. Somewhere 14 million. Well, or a little less.
▪ I have a suspicion that I have not described everything. And this suspicion is very well justified.

notes.title: Massive Patch!
notes.content:
A Very Big Patch is coming to you :)

1. Completely redesigned sound engine:
1.1 All music is aligned to the same volume level. 
1.2 The first track and the boss track are made quieter.
1.3 Menu sounds and other clicks are calibrated. They are made quieter.
1.4 All other sounds and music are recalibrated and volume aligned.
1.5 Main Kitty's meow became louder!)
1.6 The voice of NPC became louder.
1.7 Sound tuning and reworking will continue. I will adjust according to your requests)

2. Reworked the system of statistics:
2.1 The display of statistics for each level now holds more information. 
2.2 The statistics is aligned more beautiful and convenient.
2.3 Very long nicknames are correctly processed now, and they do not go over the edge of the window))

3. fixes a very rare problem at the end of levels 20 and 31.

4. Completely reworked the window mode!
4.1 The game now correctly switches from full screen to window mode (hopefully).
4.2 Change the screen resolution correctly and quickly.
4.3 The game starts correctly in the mode you left the game in.
4.4 Fixed bug when window mode was switched to "window without frame".
4.5 Full gamepad support for controlling window and graphics settings.

5. Improved gamepad support!
5.1 Improved display of icons and hints with Xbox and DualShock gamepads.

6. A large, huge number of small, invisible fixes to the engine.
